analogy.rationale: Voltage-gated sodium channels (SCN5A/9A/10A/4A) are poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so sodium channel blockers should elicit little transcriptional response; local anesthetics share the same target and similarly weak effect, while other ion-channel blockers may show modest overlap in transport/electrophysiology-related programs.
